key_insight: ProIQA assesses math item quality by modeling the solving process, not just the problem stem, to better judge educational value.
engineering_relevance: It offers a scalable framework for filtering and improving AIG math items in intelligent tutoring and assessment pipelines.
method: Form process-aware IQA across knowledge concepts, difficulty, and disciplinary competencies.
Build structured reasoning trees from raw solutions using LLMs.
Encode reasoning trees with GNNs and fuse them with stem semantics in a dual-view "Stem + Solving" model.
evidence_signal: Experiments on K12 math datasets show the framework captures process-oriented features and supports fine-grained quality assessment.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of LLM-generated reasoning trees and the availability of reliable solution traces.
paper_title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
